title: Mind Body Problem
definition: The philosophical exploration of the relationship between the mind and the body.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Thinking about how our thoughts and feelings are connected to our physical bodies.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The Mind-Body Problem involves the analysis of concepts like dualism, materialism, and functionalism.
difficulty_levels.expert: At its core, The Mind-Body Problem is a long-standing philosophical question that has been explored through various theories.
